title_raw: ONE HUNDRED AND FOURTY GROUPS BAGS CDF GRANTS
excerpt_raw: 2.8 million kwacha CDF was disbursed to 140 community groups in Samfya district in 2026; cumulative beneficiary groups since 2022 were reported as over 600.

title_raw: A 30 MILLION KWACHA HARBOR COMPLETED AND READY FOR USE
excerpt_raw: Government through the Ministry of Transport and Logistics disbursed over K30 million for a Samfya harbor and support facilities; the project was reported completed and awaiting commissioning.

title_raw: GOVERNMENT BACKS SAMFYA INVESTMENT POTENTIAL WITH KEY PROJECTS
excerpt_raw: Article describes government interventions in tourism, trade, transportation and infrastructure in Samfya.

title_raw: TOWNSHIP ROAD MAINTAINANCE SOLIDIFIED WITH GOVERNMENT FUNDING
excerpt_raw: Government funding was reported for maintenance of 22 kilometres of township roads.

title_raw: Traditional leaders in Samfya rally behind upcoming Luapula Expo
excerpt_raw: Traditional leaders welcomed the Luapula investment expo and council engagement around investment potential.

title_raw: SAMFYA YOUTHS APPLAUDS GOVERNMENT FOR PROFFESSIONAL ENROLLMENT OPPORTUNITY PROVIDED BY THE CONSTITUENCY DEVELOPMENT FUND
excerpt_raw: Bangweulu School of Nursing and Midwifery students discussed CDF-enabled professional training opportunities.

title_raw: SAMFYA TOWN COUNCIL AND NORTEC FORMS A PACT
excerpt_raw: Samfya Town Council and NORTEC agreed to cooperate around bursary beneficiaries and skills development.

title_raw: SAMFYA DISTRICT SEES BOOST IN FEEDER ROADS CONSTRUCTION
excerpt_raw: CDF road activity reported over K3 million annual allocation to the roads component; 26 km township roads completed and 30 km feeder roads opened.

title_raw: SAMFYA YOUTHFUL ENTREPRENUERS MANIFEST QUALITY WORK
excerpt_raw: Council reported satisfaction with youthful local contractors and suppliers working on CDF projects.
Council reported disbursement of over K2.4 million to over 100 indigenous businesses under CDF empowerment.

title_raw: SAMFYA’S CHINSANKA AND MABO KUNDA COMMUNITIES RECEIVE NEW HEALTH FACILITIES
excerpt_raw: Two CDF-funded maternity annexes were reported for Mabo Kunda (Isamba Ward) and Chinsanka (Kapata Ward), with stated project costs of K2,256,000 and K1,181,000 respectively.
Samfya reported commissioning a CDF ambulance for Bangweulu Constituency.

title_raw: SAMFYA DISTRICT RIPE FOR TOURISM DEVELOPMENT
excerpt_raw: Article reports tourism development investments including a Tourism Information Center at Samfya Beach.
Seventeen construction projects from 2022 CDF funding were reported at K12.8 million, including 19 classrooms and 5 health facilities.
Samfya Town Council reported procurement of a TLB and a compactor using 2022 CDF for road and infrastructure works.

title_raw: SAMFYA SCHOOLS IN A DESK BONANZA
excerpt_raw: Council reported procurement of 4,249 desks for schools across all ten wards, amounting to over K6 million under the 2023 CDF.
